_comment: Member accessions of repository SuperSeries whose inventory row names only the parent (CAAIL-258). Keyed by ds: id -> array of bare uppercase member accessions. Curator-maintained and DB-only, like dois-related.json; folded by db:reseed-axes and validated by db:check. Every entry here was read from the parent's own GEO Series relation record, never inferred from a title or a sample count. A member that also has its own inventory row is resolved to it at parse; one that does not is still served, so nothing in the corpus is unreachable.
